name: Spacing Out
source:
Spacing Out is a charming visual novel that delves into the hardships and highlights of entering post secondary. Embark on a journey with our airheaded space geek protagonist as they navigate the endless clusters of work, forge new friendships, pursue their ambitions, and uncover the uncharted territories of romance.

[From [url=https://anjx101.itch.io/spacing-out]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Spaceing Out》是一部迷人的视觉小说，深入探讨了进入中学后的艰辛和亮点。与我们头脑简单的太空极客主角一起踏上旅程，他们将处理无尽的工作，结交新的友谊，追求他们的抱负，并揭开未知的浪漫领域。

[来自[url=https://anjx101.itch.io/spacing-out]itch.io[/url]]
